notes.title: Relax this weekend with the Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration
notes.content:
Congratulations! You have survived another month 🌻

We can already touch the end of the week with our fingertips and you deserve to take a break doing what you love the most: [b]playing videogames[/b]. 

Well, you're in luck! Because if you're looking for a new story to immerse yourself in for hours at your own pace, the [b]Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration is here[/b]. An amazing event highlighting sales, demos and more for cozy and amazing games.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819460/Mika_and_The_Witchs_Mountain/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/db107b578187429049bbf148270f502994cbc65a.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Featuring: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain with 30% off[/h3]
Our proposal for this event is our game about being a young delivery witch who rides a flying broomstick around a charming island that you can explore from top to bottom. 

You may ask: [i]is it inspired by Kiki's Delivery Service? Does it look like The Legend of Zelda Wind Waker?[/i] Yes, it does! These were our biggest inspirations to create a little adventure to have a good time and touch your heart 🩷

[previewyoutube=tub-jcjV0Kw;full](trailer)[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Enjoy now all the extra free content[/h3]
We hear our community asking for more content for the base game, and it’s finally here! 

You can enjoy the [b]3 Free Content Patches[/b] to expand your experience playing Mika and the Witch’s Mountain. In case you’re wondering what includes:

[list]
[*] Fishing (non-harmful) minigame.
[*] Feed the Kitties minigame.
[*] Churro Express racing minigame. 
[*] 3 Zelda-like dungeons. 
[*] New outfits, characters, areas and collectables. 
[*] New languages (Valencian, Japanese and Chinese).
[*] +3 hours of additional gameplay.
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819460/Mika_and_The_Witchs_Mountain/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/bf4cecc38083dd3c7b19cf01d8b74fd185792ca5.png[/img][/url]

Please let us know your experience if you choose Mika and the Witch’s Mountain to have a great time — Fly high! 💫

notes.title: New FREE Content Update: Into the Mount Gaun is now available!
notes.content:
Mika and the Witch's Mountain's latest free content patch [b]IS NOW READY TO PLAY[/b] 🎉

[b]Extra:[/b] we are aware that these dungeons can be challenging for some players, so we have prepared [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/10otJkS214b8QiGVQyovGt0K0MdnC-n9g/view?usp=sharing]this guide[/url] to help you complete them more easily if you need to.

Check the trailer:

[previewyoutube=x8OZK5VtyY8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Into The Mont Gaun - The 3 Zelda-like Dungeons[/h2]

Into the Mont Gaun is Mika's final test to become a real witch and master the winds with her magic broom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/f54b98e004f624d2da65bfa2493587b7f3a0c659.png[/img]

The Simiente has some final challenges to complete your witch training and has promised a great reward. Are you up to it?

You will have found some altars scattered around the island during your deliveries, right? Well, they are the access points to get into the mountain, where you’ll find:

[h3]The Dungeon of the Fire[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/471dd6082a4444c4fa3698fef66580cb906a521f.png[/img]

[h3]The Dungeon of the Wind[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/1f46937e7259cf8a785321846e1d0a6cc3e43735.png[/img]

[h3]The Dungeon of the Water[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/b5210ac540ba7658d863005d42d543b1357790a5.png[/img]

Each of these dungeons presents different challenges where you will test your skills and wit. The goal? [b]Reaching the top[/b] ([i]sound familiar? haha[/i]) of each dungeon to get the elemental magic trail of each one.

Pay attention! In addition to solving the puzzles, there are also [b]hidden secrets[/b] (4 in each dungeon, 12 in total). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/7a109283f1d696b5b760910eb118e3dc06406aa5.png[/img]


[h2]The Green Witch outfit[/h2]
[i]“Now you master the winds”[/i]

The last and perhaps most anticipated of Mika's outfits, the Green Witch, is your reward for completing the challenges of the Simiente.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/c67412c3b2f3e56b73855f987715db400a2a7b59.png[/img]

This outfit has been worn by all the adventurous witches who came before Mika to Mont Gaun seeking to meet its challenges. When completed, they were considered masters of the wind, as they could control the broom flight to perfection. 

With this costume, upward flight is unlocked, so Mika can now also fly her broom in that direction. A very inviting possibility if you wanted to enjoy a long flight around the island, reach a last corner to explore or take some nice pictures!


[h2]It’s Chibig’s 8th Aniversary![/h2]
Haaappy Biiiirthday tooo uuuus 🎉🎉🎉

It's our eighth anniversary since our adventure as indie game developers began, and many exciting things are happening at once!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/abraham-cozar/elusive][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/29ab0f6166a0c4496f9597cbd3ff387ad6bdd6c2.png[/img][/url]

In addition to this content update, we've also announced [b]Elusive[/b], our new adventure where we'll be stepping into the tiny boots of a young raider following in her father's footsteps in the world of giants. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/chibig/sale/ChibigUniverseofGamesSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/b4c7c5d519633e58b4cd7cc3ccbbf58e3512c661.png[/img][/url]

We are also celebrating our first Publisher Event on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/chibig/sale/ChibigUniverseofGamesSale][b]Chibig Universe of Games Sale[/b][/url], so if you want to complete your collection of Chibig games or get into this universe of interconnected adventures for the first time, it's the perfect time!

notes.title: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain full launch is happening on January 22
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

It may come as a bit of a surprise, but it will make the wait a little shorter: [b]Mika and the Witch's Mountain launches on January 22nd![/b]🎉🎉🎉

This includes all platforms: PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series, and it marks the end of the Early Access period. 

The game inspired by Kiki’s Delivery Service was launched on Early Access on Steam and Nintendo Switch last August 21st, and has sold 60,000 copies so far, with a very positive reception from players.

[previewyoutube=40ZjpCYh6PI;full][/previewyoutube]

To encourage everyone to join this special event and enjoy the adventures of Mika, the delivery witch, [b]we’ll be hosting a 30% launch discount[/b] on Steam.

[i]And what about the promised content still to be added? [/i]Don't worry, we haven't forgotten✨ The Zelda-like dungeons are in the final stages of development and will be added shortly after launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/24d177d2d57213dbcb181cf152ca9f45e202c314.png[/img]

During these 4 months, the team has taken the opportunity to listen to the community's opinion and developed more content into the game for free. Thank you so much for being part of this!

2 of the 3 Content Patches planned, beyond bug fixing and improving performance, are now available and add:
[list]
[*] Fishing Minigame.
[*] Churro Express racing minigame.
[*] Save the Kitten minigame.
[*] Pet companion.
[*] New languages.
[*] New cosmetics.
[*] More achievements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/70bb234afe66286688cc96e30d3a1e29ef93c74a.png[/img]

If you want to know more about all this new content, check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1819460/view/4505380324413894012?l=english]First Content Patch[/url] Update and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1819460/view/517447479138976486]Second Content Patch[/url] Update.

The “[i]Into the Mont Gaun[/i]” Third Content Patch, will come in the following weeks, including [b]3 dungeons to explore the depths of the island[/b] where the adventure takes place, with a very similar vibe to the dungeons of The Legend of Zelda games. 

This Third Content Patch will be the last one, completing all the content planned for the game before the successful Kickstarter campaign in 2023, and providing around 8 hours of gameplay.

Can’t wait to celebrate this extremely exciting event with you all, see you next week!✨

notes.title: Second FREE Content Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hello deliverers! How are your flights across the Isle of the Winds going?

We have important news for you, as the Roadmap published at the beginning of the Early Access has suffered a slight modification - but it has an explanation!

We have received many messages from the community suggesting changes and improvements to make the game experience better, but there is one of them that has stood out above all others: the addition of the minimap. 

[i]What's going to happen to the planned content? [/i]
Nothing bad! Just that now, instead of 2 Content Patches, there will be 3. So in this second Content Patch it will be included:

[list]
[*] Fishing minigame
[*] Minimap
[*] New language: Valencian
[/list]

Take a look to the trailer!
[previewyoutube=ryNgWX6xyIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The Third Content Patch will include the Dungeons, and we have to confess that we’re very proud of how their design and development is progressing!

[h3]Minimap[/h3]
Although it has been difficult to find the balance between a clean interface and the addition of a useful minimap, we have succeeded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/d6c4faa3a6b2afbe833cd1e803446c76ba748630.png[/img]

You will now have the help of a minimap in the upper right corner of the screen, which you can make a little bigger by pressing the right arrow key.

[h3]Fishing Minigame[/h3]
As you know, old seawolf O'Vel is nostalgic for the days when he sailed the seas, and fish are a nice reminder of those times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/8cc0a357ec7199720c8b71810e28009ce975554b.jpg[/img]

In this minigame you can bring him back the joy by bringing him some of the fish that roam the waters of Mont Gaun, but don't think it will be easy!

We had a lot of fun designing this minigame and creating these little friends, so hope you like it. 

[h3]New language: Valencian[/h3]
Like all our previous games, Mika and the Witch's Mountain had to include Valencian among its languages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/40d49bad62e665242aa3b400370c153933dcef68.png[/img]

We know that very few people will play in this language, but we are very proud of our land and language!

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
We have also added some small performance improvements and minor bugs:
[list]
[*] Improved fire effects
[*] Fixed various occlusion artifacts across the island
[/list]

[h3]Extra: discount to celebrate the Second Content Patch![/h3]
If you haven't yet decided to play Mika and the Witch's Mountain, we have prepared a week's discount for you to get the game and enjoy this experience until the arrival of the latest content patch. 

Enjoy!

- - - -

The end of Early Access is near, which means that you won't have to wait long to enjoy the Third Content Patch. 

As always, thank you very much for your support and for helping us to make Mika and the Witch's Mountain a better game. 

Fly High!

notes.title: Major FREE Update CHURROS & CATS is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/70bb234afe66286688cc96e30d3a1e29ef93c74a.png[/img]

[h3]Our First Free Content Patch is now available on Steam! [/h3]
Here's the official trailer to highlight the new quests/minigames, features and cosmetics you'll find in your delivery adventure

[previewyoutube=xoY9uyiAIPI;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, the Mika and the Witch’s Mountain + OST bundle is now available at special price

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44215/Mika_Collection/


[h2]Churro Express minigame[/h2]
Awan, the Ank, has come to Orilla Town to set up his chocolate & churro business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/43e4000db567da466b04b0eed367fe066c5a4a22.png[/img]

He wants to try an innovative home delivery service, but he needs someone who can do it at the right time so that the chocolate doesn't get cold. 

In this minigame you will have to complete [b]7 circuits scattered all over The Island of the Winds[/b] in a given time to demonstrate your skills with the magic broom. Have you mastered the twists and turns and the air currents?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/3714f26694209860a25d949e20f21ed59b22edf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/25c2580eb2e174ab02ea9111395fbc54f9854135.png[/img]

Churro Express minigame is unlocked after the delivery of the drone invoice package (Andros and twins) and completing it successfully will give you the Mika Churrera skin and the keychain of the toy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/8c828fc6b4480b1dd7473a2c0993415d33500f80.png[/img]

[i]Note: for those of you who have played previous Chibig adventures, such as Summer in Mara, yes! Awan appears in other games. [/i]

[h2]Save the Kitties minigame[/h2]
Kitty and cute animal lovers, we need you!

[b]5 kittens[/b] have come to Orilla Town for shelter, but they are very hungry — could you feed them (please say yes)?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/d1cbbb1fc1d08088c01e5d435964dbd391f77833.png[/img]

Collect the cans of food that you can get at the Amazing Deliveries office and find each kitten to feed them.

This mini-game will be available after completing Act 3.

[h2]The Pet Companion[/h2]
After completing the special training that Miss Olagari had prepared for you, many things have changed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/d7ba835e78cc9555808269ccc03730689047ef2f.png[/img]

One of the first rewards you have earned is the Companion,[b] Edgar The Crow[/b], who will now fly with you every time you get on your broom. 

[i]Note: you must be equipped with the Raven keychain for Edgar to appear.[/i]

[h2]New cosmetics and achievements[/h2]
This First Free Content Patch also includes [b]2 new outfits[/b]: Churrera and Magical Girl and [b]4 new keychains[/b] to the marketplace: cat, crow, star and toy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/de4d1b8d733b9367c7b45d2a8d7300f0b73949e6.png[/img]

The Napopo statues and coins will be readjusted for you to purchase them successfully, no worries!

Also , related to the new minigames, there are [b]2 new achievements[/b]: one for the Churro Express and other for the Save the Kittens - you will have to fly around the magical Island of the Winds again if you want to get the 100%!


[h3][i]Now What?[/i][/h3]
Well, there are still some [b]languages to be added[/b] and the development of the [b]Second Content Patch[/b] has already started. 

In addition, since launch we have been able to fix and improve many other aspects of the game, in part, thanks to your feedback here and on [url=https://discord.gg/chibig]Discord[/url]. We hope we can continue to count on your support to keep doing so in the coming months. 

Fly high!

notes.title: SteamDeck verified!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Almost a week after the official Early Access release (thank you so much for your support in all possible ways!) and here we are with some news and info hopefully answering your most frequent questions.

[h3]Steam Deck Verified[/h3]

Woohoo! Some of you already confirmed that Mika and the Witch’s Mountain runs smoothly on Steam Deck, but [b]now it's official[/b] 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/193ec312402cf508f395d45f0e25446ec14fc6b4.png[/img]

This is amazing news for us, as we know Mika is a very “portable game” to play while relaxing on the couch or bed, even to liven a trip up!

[h3]Known issues, Work in Progress and Suggestions[/h3]

After the last patch to fix, in addition to other minor issues, the “airplane bug”, we have detected new ones:

[list]
[*] Napopos tutorials popping up more than once.
[*] Multiple achievements do not unlock. 
[/list]

We are aware and currently working to fix it in a new patch as soon as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/d7b5c30c91933cc66a9ced506fd4edcd2a3b34d7.png[/img]

[h3]Community feedback and suggestions[/h3]
We’re happy to have launched the game in Early Access because in just one week we have been able to collect a lot of valuable suggestions that we will value to incorporate in the coming months. 

Some of the most repeated suggestions that we're considering implementing:
[list]
[*] Open/close Option and Deliver Card Menu with one button. 
[*] Minimap. 
[*] Add a Tutorial section to view again the tutorial messages. 
[*] Inverting camera X axis option in menu
[/list]

Also, thank you so much to all the people leaving reviews here! It's very important to us and other future players on Steam, so thank you for taking the time to do it :D

notes.title: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:

This is one of [b]our goals for this Early Acces[/b]s period that starts today: to make a better experience together, so thank you so much!!

But these things aside, [b]MIKA IS LAUNCHING TODAY!! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/bb128173a2bbd91a649ad6f9bcbaccf940d75112.jpg[/img]

You have no idea how eager we were for this day to arrive, we were dreaming about you all soaring around the Island of the Winds, discovering all the secrets, meeting amazing characters and feeling this story we built with the best we have. 

Please [b]let us know with a review, a comment or anything else[/b] you want your thoughts and experience, and let other people around the world know about this little witch that delivers packages in a mini open world. Also, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/chibig]Discord [/url] server. 

Have a great launch day all!!

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi all! Everyone hyped for the upcoming release ([i]we really are!![/i])

We thought we would dedicate an update to explain in detail [b]the roadmap after the Early Access[/b] release of Mika and the Witch's Mountain and the content updates planned ([i]and already in development![/i])

[h3]Let's develop a bit more about the 2 content patches:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/70bb234afe66286688cc96e30d3a1e29ef93c74a.png[/img]

These content patches will contain [b]3 major blocks[/b]:
[list]
[*] New content for the game (missions, collectibles...).
[*] Bug fixes and inclusion of new languages.
[*] Community feedback implementation.
[/list]

The forecast is to add the first content patch approximately 2 months after the August 21 release, and another 2 months later for the second content patch after the first one; but ([i]hopefully not![/i]) some unforeseen event could influence this forecast.

[h2]Content description:[/h2]

[h3]First content patch[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/dab14c8a796379b2c9d60f5b1ecab7df6ae970ac.png[/img]
[b]Churro Express minigame[/b]
A new character arrives to the Isle of Winds! A special mission will be unlocked where we will have to prove ourselves in a race against the clock delivering churros around the island.

This minigame will unlock Mika churrera's outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/6192df171a7e3a15f7cea11bbe23f2111f884ff2.png[/img]
[b]Kitties minigame[/b]
Kitty lovers, we've heard you. There's a bunch of kittens all over the island who need the help of an experienced delivery witch, please help them!

[h3]Second content patch[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/c1168374a03281abbf371ffd2d0f9edf064e4593.png[/img]
[b]Fishing minigame[/b]
Old sailor O'Vel is a big lover and protector of fish, he would surely be excited to see all the new fish that have appeared on the shores of Orilla Town. Grab a fish tank and gently try to catch them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/24d177d2d57213dbcb181cf152ca9f45e202c314.png[/img]
[b]Dungeons[/b]
The great Mont Gaun hides many secrets, but even more inside. Delve into the heart of the mountain and explore every nook and cranny to learn more about its history and magic.

These quests will unlock more trails for your magic broom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/67e9d400b0780042a423d45f286ec8def77a1494.png[/img]
[b]New languages[/b] (Japanese and Korean) will be added during this period, as well as all bug fixes and community feedback we receive. We invite you to be part of this process and share your experience and suggestions with us. 

As we’ve mentioned, we hope to follow this plan, but we’re aware that it may be altered for many reasons, so we thank you in advance for your support and understanding. We hope you’ll join us during these following months and play Mika and the Witch's Mountain to discover all this new content!

—The Chibig Team

notes.title: 2 week to go!
notes.content:
Guess which witch ([i]hehe[/i]) game is releasing in 2 weeks…OMG MIKA AND THE WITCH’S MOUNTAIN!! ✨

There's still a lot to prepare for the big day, but for now we wanted to answer some of the most repeated questions from the community that you may have wondered about: 

[h3][b]Is the game compatible with Steam Deck?[/b][/h3]
Although we don't have the verification [i]yet[/i], we are aware that many people want to play Mika and the Witch's Mountain on Steam Deck ([i]it's a game that you want to play lying quietly on the couch, not gonna lie[/i]), so we are doing our best to make it work and look good. Here's an example:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaDQyZWZxOGFvMWlveHp3Yno5NzZhdjdiZzh2ZnEyMXh3dDJ4cHhmcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/UNQ8DRYbsGhtXUOFHk/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3]
This addresses several questions we have received, but we would like to mention the configuration options that you’ve suggested to us during this time and that you will have to custom your gaming experience to your preferences:

[list]
[*] [u]Audio[/u] - Music & Effects volume
[*] [u]Controls[/u] - Invert jump, invert camera and camera sensibility
[*] [u]Graphics[/u] - Brightness, Depth of Field, Performance...and more!
[*] [i]Yes, there’s autosave and manual save (it saves when you exit the game).[/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]Does Early Access mean that the game will be released incomplete?[/b][/h3]
Not at all! The complete adventure will be included in [b]the August 21st release[/b], but we want to take the opportunity of an EA ([i]Early Access[/i]) to add more content to explore in depth ([i]this is a small advance hehe[/i]) the mountain and also take into consideration your feedback after playing the game.

It's our first time launching in Early Access and we are looking forward to hearing your feedback!

—---------------------------

That's all for now, see you soon with new updates!

notes.title: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain will be out on August 21
notes.content:
ATTENTION EVERYONE PLEASE! We have a ✨✨✨✨ release date ✨✨✨✨

The adventures of our young witch [b]Mika will arrive on Steam and Nintendo Switch on August 21st[/b].

[i]aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa[/i]

Here is the new release date trailer:

[previewyoutube=MyRmqMqVEVI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Delivery Update #4 - Packages, OST, tarot cards and more
notes.content:
One more development update, one step closer to the launch!

Here’s a summary of what we’re talking about today:

[list]
[*] New cinematic: second fragment
[*] Packages: how to (not) break, wet or mess
[*] Tarot cards ingame: gotta find em all!
[*] OST: Mark Sparling x Adrian Berenguer collab
[/list]

[h3]New cinematic: second fragment[/h3]

Here you have some new frames of the new cinematic that our friends from Alkimia Animation Studio are preparing for Mika and the Witch's Mountain.  https://www.alkimiastudio.com/

As you know these new animations will support some parts of the gameplay to enrich your game experience.

[previewyoutube=xlE4TCFz30I;full][/previewyoutube]

It looks like Greff is having some trouble carrying all those packages, he sure could use the help of a certain little witch and her magic broom!


[h3]Packages: how to (not) break, wet or mess[/h3]
Good news: all the deliveries of the critical path of the game are proudly implemented and tested.

Also bad news: for those who thought Mika and the Witch's Mountain would be as simple as carrying packages back and forth without worry or difficulty, there’s more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/3b7f46422ad3273078dd6af39e705ca0e75fba0a.png[/img]

Not only are you going to have to find the recipients of the packages being the newcomer to the Island of the Winds, but you're going to have to be careful not to break them or get them wet - you're even going to have limited time to do so in some cases!

But it's going to be fun, promise! Of course, for those of you who want to have your delivery card full of positive ratings (green stamps) you may need to repeat a few deliveries.


[h3]Tarot cards ingame: gotta find em all![/h3]
Another feature of the game successfully implemented and tested are the tarot cards, which you will be able to collect inside the game...but we’re not going to give more details! 

We will only say that you will have to go all over the island to get them, which means that you will have to [b]improve your broom to the maximum[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/07fe22d088ad9527b6e307b2e114240631029fc7.png[/img]

Another bad news is that some of you might want to get the tarot cards in physical form after playing Mika and the Witch's Mountain. Sorry! haha


[h3]OST: Mark Sparling x Adrian Berenguer collab[/h3]
It’s treat time! One of the many stretch goals promised on the Kickstarter campaign is completed: [b]the special song composed by Mark Sparling and Adrian Berengue[/b]r is done!

[previewyoutube=_LF9kkjbdUo;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may know, Adrian Berenguer work is present in previous Chibig’s games and A Short Hike is one of the biggest inspirations for Mika and the Witch’s Mountain, so this collab is something really special to us.

It was an honor to have such a unique piece in the game OST, hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we do!



A pretty long update, sorry! See you next month with more new about Mika and the Witch’s Mountain development.

Fly high!

notes.content:

notes.title: Delivery Update #3 - New cinematic, mailbox feature and final outfits emotes
notes.content:
Did you think we would leave you without an update this month? Not at all!

This time, we’ll be showing new art content that has been recently added to the game and hopefully you’ll appreciate it! Let’s jump into the new cinematic and outfit final illustrations:

[h2]New cinematic first fragment[/h2]

Our friends from [url=https://www.alkimiastudio.com/]Alkimia Animation Studio[/url] have accompanied us since the beginning of the development of Mika and the Witch's Mountain to create the incredible animated scenes that you can see in the trailer.  

Since December, we have get together again to create a new additional cinematic that you will be able to see when you play the full version and that we hope will make your gaming experience even better. 

[previewyoutube=oWjAfc_zzwk;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to have it complete, but we can show you today a first fragment where we see [b]Andros and his twins Ilse and Han[/b]. All of them belong to the Elit race, which we introduced for the first time in Summer in Mara, and which are characterized by being quite…mean.

[h2]Mika outfits: final illustrations[/h2]

One of the promises we made during the Kickstarter campaign was to create new skins for Mika to collect and give, somehow, some more customization and variety to the adventure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/dbdac870e3bc07390ab7739b8b8af29af03dd2cb.png[/img]

These outfits are already modeled and successfully implemented in the game, but we've gone a step further and taken that feature down to the smallest detail: This means that every time you change the skin, Mika's appearance will change in the dialogues to match the outfit. A 100% match!

[i]*Remember that some outfits are exclusive to some campaign rewards and cannot currently be obtained, but most of them are obtained naturally by completing the game's story.[/i]

[h2]Amazing Deliveries mailbox[/h2]

Although this feature is exclusive to some of the people who supported us in the Kickstarter campaign, maybe some of them will want to share it with the rest of the community when the time comes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/9ea0ca355a1cb08f452b664ef3d6eb4c15a5a3b4.png[/img]

Next to the Amazing Deliveries building, the company Mika works for delivering packages, there is a friendly mailbox where you can enter codes to get unexpected surprises. 

[previewyoutube=p-Wm0gKRqoA;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of them will be personalized packages that the backers themselves have designed, and each of them will have a private code. We wanted to show you how it works as we are very proud of the result, but maybe you can experience it for yourself when you play Mika and the Witch's Mountain!

A new update is on the way with more info about the development, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Delivery Update #2 - NPC’s and Camera
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/5760b11c946b4bbe87fa1ed29f1a2ed88453fde8.png[/img]

Hey everyone! This is the second Delivery Update where we will be sharing these final stages of the development until the launch of the game, and today it’s time to introduce our charming NPCs and the camera:

[h2]NPCs[/h2]
Orilla Town is the only place inhabited by a group of people on the whole island (though not the only place), but we have not yet introduced you to its inhabitants!

[h3]Workers: Sailors, Vendors, Farmers and more[/h3]

A town by the sea needs a group of nostalgic but affable [b]sailors[/b] who bring fresh fish every day. Curiously, you will never catch them fishing, because the fish in these waters are too elusive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/284d75fdded395a22b14507d869e4fcd88860534.png[/img]

The cheerful [b]vendors[/b] of Orilla Town fill the streets with their energy every day in search of new customers. Don't be fooled by their friendly faces and kind words, they may be trying to sell you something you don't need!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/52a92b1f0ac75d45cd2dabc33240dabe15a39775.png[/img]

Soot & Fog Inc’s Smoke factory is Orilla Town's main source of [b]workers[/b], although it's not an easy or clean job. If you see someone stressed out, extremely tired, and with sooty clothes during your deliveries, it's probably one of the workers at the island's smoke factory.

[h3]Villagers: Kids, old people, Tourists, etc[/h3]
When you walk through the streets of Orilla Town, you will discover the life that runs through them through its people: children playing, old people enjoying a well-deserved rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/e4b3efff8367971045702870d4ef0cdf89c3e050.png[/img]

Mont Gaun may not be the most popular of all vacation destinations, but it is a little hidden gem for those looking for relaxation and, why not, some unexpected surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/ad2c52d3cb28c63e196a87b15c96d4b2766ca7ff.png[/img]

Its beaches have nothing to envy those of the Mara Islands, and are much less crowded! There is plenty of space for strolling, making sand castles, and sunbathing.

And, of course, to have an ice cream!

[h2]Camera[/h2]

As we have already shown,[b] the camera[/b] in this case can be controlled freely. This is a very positive experience for the players, who have control over it and what they see at every moment, but it poses a lot of challenges for the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/4e4595b53949112bba0a63f8291c8a83eea150ce.png[/img]

However, we have done some additional work that will help to generate a more immersive feeling and with a very remarkable visual result with these small adjustments:

[h3]Dialogues & Bubbles[/h3]
In dialogues, the [b]camera[/b] will automatically take a position to get a certain shot that shows the characters involved in the dialogue, more aesthetic and avoiding possible glitches between models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/3dd471ed87b432a9a9284ae56b935e3fef4b83c3.png[/img]

Also, we’ve added [b]bubbles[/b] to guide and help you throughout the game. Not only will they give more "life" to secondary characters and NPCs, but they will also let you know what you should do next, or who to talk to without needing to repeat a dialogue with that character.

Hope you like this a-bit-longer-than-usual update - see you soon with more fresh content!

notes.title: Delivery Update #1 - The Witchy Notebook
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/f1157ca85260329b86db8e454148d2e3eed36354.png[/img]

Hello everyone! And happy new year (can still be said?)

We're going to start a series of regular updates to give you a closer look at the final stretch of Mika and the Witch's Mountain development -[b] the release will be early this year[/b] for Steam and consoles!

In this update we want to show you the most important tool of the game (besides the flying broom, of course): the [b]Witchy Notebook[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/4e68c697a52d012c7dc97e40003a6746fbc3b126.png[/img]

In it, you will be able to check all the quests, collectibles, change Mika's costume, consult the map, and much more. Useful as well as beautiful!

The [b]Witchy Notebook[/b] will guide you to make your deliveries without fail and get the best ratings, and it will also make you want to explore this small island full of secrets and surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/9b7fab75330af9e1b2378fa86af17554fa5728ec.png[/img]

Mika will have different outfits and you will also be able to get other aesthetic elements for her broom and more collectibles. You will be able to change and customize them from your notebook as you unlock them.

You will be able to browse the map to see all the important locations, your position at anytime and also everything you have left to explore on the island, which we warn you is going to be a lot!

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
It’s that time of the year again: it’s Steam Next Fest!

The bad part is that we’re not officially participating, the good part is that we have decided to activate the demo again for those of you who have not been able to play Mika and the Witch's Mountain yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/76a27cf1f4da3e211cb254b1e4ee93251188f0f0.png[/img]

[h3][b]What can you expect from the demo?[/b][/h3]
This demo allows you to make some package deliveries while flying with your broom and talking to some of the inhabitants of Orilla Town. 

[b]The goal is to show the main mechanics[/b] of the game: flying with Mika's magic broom and delivering packages. It also shows a small part of the island, which in the full game you will be able to explore in depth and in different ways to meet new characters, find treasures, collectibles and advance in your adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/74ca076a7d465c7732c83a9f29fb487e9bbb855c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Can I play only with a gamepad?[/b][/h3]
Although we recommend playing Mika and the Witch's Mountain with a controller, you can also play it with keyboard and mouse, but keep in mind that the controls will be different.

[h3][b]Join our Wishlist Marathon[/b][/h3]
October is the month of witches and we have prepared a challenge to push Mika and the Witch's Mountain wishlist so that more people discover this little adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/34310c7495890a1b352850d76a4e922fe5cbe34b.png[/img]

Every time we reach the goal we will reveal new game content never shown before, so if you want to know more remember to put it on your wishlist!

Hope you all enjoy the demo and have an amazing Steam Next Fest time discovering new games. 

See you soon!

notes.title: New outfits, Churro Express and summer events
notes.content:
Hello bewitched friends!

This is going to be a pretty big update, but there’s a lot of stuff we want to share with you after an amazing but exhausting summer. Here’s an overview:

[list]
[*] Attending live events with Mika and the Witch’s Mountain demo.
[*] First look at Mika physical exclusive items.
[*] Mika’s new outfit collection and Churro Express minigame first steps.
[*] News about the release.
[/list]

[h2][b]Attending live events with Mika and the Witch’s Mountain demo[/b][/h2]
We always try to be part of online gaming events so that more and more people get to know Mika and the Witch's Mountain and want to live the adventures of our little delivery witch when the time comes. 

However, this summer we had the opportunity to do it live at[b] two very special events[/b]: Gamescom (Köln, Germany) and IndieDevDay (Barcelona, Spain). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/c6032b705fce2575deb566816330685b26744e81.png[/img]

Mika's demo (yes, the one you have played here on Steam!) was available in a beautiful booth during those days together with her dear friend Koa, from Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara. [b]We received a lot of positive feedback[/b] from all the people who played it or came to the booth, especially for its lovely artwork ♡

But it doesn't end there, tomorrow starts [b]Tokyo Games Show[/b] 2023 edition and Mika will be there with our friends from Pikii. Come by and say hello!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/0b01daacf54e12456513abde6e73228cd85cd6ae.png[/img]

[h2][b]First look at Mika physical exclusive items[/b][/h2]
Related to this, we’re also very proud to show the first samples we have received of some of the most special physical rewards of the Kickstarter campaign: the [b]figure with the special packaging[/b] and the [b]tarot card deck[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/f138b494792aaf3b6fefccc7625f3fc120eafc90.png[/img]

Production to make delivery to campaign backers has already started, but at Chibig Atelier you can [b]preorder either one for a limited time[/b]. Maybe you missed the opportunity during the Kickstarter or you just saw this adorable figure and now you need it in your collection - you can still get it!

[i]*The exclusive box that simulates the packages Mika delivers in the game is only for backers of the campaign with a pledge that originally included the figure. Current preorders do not include it.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/e149dde65a0150c94f06852a9708b5a37066f3db.png[/img]

[h2][b]Mika’s new outfit collection and Churro Express minigame first steps[/b][/h2]
Let’s go straight to the point: look how amazing the new outfits look on Mika!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/aa658c594d04ad843d00e1a2baaa8ab4d532ec99.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/ab0f6e269305d3e4bc2ef396577da3bd594da9bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/40c619e39474197c7d97e989d1a5d008585dfd50.png[/img]

These outfits were not initially planned in the development of the game, but were added as a result of the Kickstarter campaign. Most of them [b]will be available to all players[/b], whatever the platform, but remember that one of them is exclusive to people who supported the campaign and another one is exclusive to backers who supported the figure also during Kickstarter.

On the other hand, the design of the new minigames and dungeons is going as planned! We don't want to make too many spoilers and the graphics are still to be finished, but the [b]Churro Express minigame[/b] looks this good: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/b7bfe3c86ae0155e50fc67d69fda82d0adb348a9.png[/img]

And with a little [b]surprise for those of you who have played [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962580/Summer_in_Mara/]Summer in Mara[/url][/b]. We can't say more! Just one more little detail that builds this universe of Chibig games (Chibigverse some people call it hehe).

[h2][b]News about the release[/b][/h2]
Unfortunately, it's not all good news, but we always want to be transparent with the development of our games, so here goes: [b]Mika and the Witch's Mountain will be released in 2024[/b].

The new content to be added after the Kickstarter campaign affects the original development plan of the game and, although in these past months we wanted to try to maintain it with all our strength, it’s not possible without compromising the dynamics and values of the team (in other words, without crunch). 

We have refocused the production plan and now Mika's team has 2 more people who will help us to meet these expectations we have in the project. This decision has been very difficult for us, but [b]we are as eager to make a good game as you are to play it[/b], and for that we need more time. 

We hope that everything we have prepared for October will help you to look forward to the game, but until then we can't say more!

Thank you for your support, fly high!

notes.title: Demo available until June 26!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello delivery witches! [/h1]

It's Steam Next Fest week but we can't join this time as we participated on the first 2023 edition. But don't panic [i]yet[/i]! [b]The demo will be available all this week until next Monday 26th![/b] Woohoo!

The demo is a small journey through the beginning of Mika's adventure, where you will meet some of the most important characters and you will be able to make some deliveries with your magic broom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/e29eda0de155e6795bf3389bb71b7b65ddb19629.png[/img]

To keep the surprise once the full version of the game arrives, the island is limited, but you can explore every corner of Orilla Town and the beach - there are many hidden details, especially if you've played the previous Chibig titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890267/216e7147f1d2d3f122d613872c98548768b7bc57.png[/img]

In future updates we will show more about how the development is progressing: new animations, Mika's skins and mini games. 

Hope you enjoy the demo, don't forget to make a wishlist!
